items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage at the labour court
items.quote: Eine Klage gegen die Kündigung ist beim Arbeitsgericht Musterbrandenburg möglich; dafür gilt eine Frist von drei Wochen ab dem Zugang dieser Kündigung.
items.computation: The letter was handed over in person on Thu 19.11.2026 with a signed Empfangsbestätigung, so Zugang (actual receipt) = 19.11.2026. Under § 4 KSchG the 3-week period to bring a Kündigungsschutzklage starts the day after Zugang (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): counting begins 20.11.2026. Three weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) is Thu 10.12.2026, a normal working day in Brandenburg, so no weekend/holiday shift (§ 193 BGB) is needed. Due date: 10.12.2026 (the claim must reach the Arbeitsgericht by that day).

items.title: Register as arbeitsuchend with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Sie sind verpflichtet, sich unverzüglich bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend zu melden.
items.computation: Under § 38 Abs. 1 SGB III, if less than three months lie between the notice and the end of employment, the employee must register as arbeitsuchend within 3 days of being informed of the end date. Notice/knowledge of the end date: Thu 19.11.2026; end of employment 31.12.2026 (less than 3 months away), so the 3-day rule applies. Day of notice not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analogously, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X): counting starts 20.11.2026, three days later = Sun 22.11.2026. As the last day falls on a Sunday, it shifts to the next working day under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB: Mon 23.11.2026. This date has already passed as of today (24.11.2026) — registration should be done immediately if not already done.

items.title: Take remaining paid leave (Resturlaub)
items.quote: Ihren Resturlaub nehmen Sie bitte bis zu diesem Tag.
items.computation: "Diesem Tag" refers back to the stated end of the employment relationship, 31.12.2026 ("kündigen wir deshalb ordentlich und fristgemäß zum 31.12.2026"). Remaining leave must therefore be taken by 31.12.2026.

items.title: Return the branch keys
items.quote: Die Schlüssel der Filiale geben Sie an Ihrem letzten Arbeitstag bei der Filialleitung ab.
items.computation: The last working day coincides with the end of the employment relationship on 31.12.2026, as no earlier release from work duties is mentioned. Keys are due back on that day.

warnings: The statutory deadline to register as arbeitsuchend with the Agentur für Arbeit (around 22.-23.11.2026, three days after the notice) has already passed as of today, 24.11.2026 — register without further delay to avoid a waiting-period penalty (Sperrzeit) on unemployment benefit.

The three-week deadline to file a Kündigungsschutzklage (by 10.12.2026) is a hard court deadline; this is information, not legal advice — contact a union, an employment lawyer, or the Rechtsantragstelle of the Arbeitsgericht promptly if you want to challenge the dismissal.
No reference numbers (e.g. Personalnummer) are printed anywhere on this letter.
